title: US Disasters Now Strike 20 Times A Year
hook: Billion-dollar US disasters now strike about 20 times a year.
closing: More frequent disasters push higher costs onto insurers, taxpayers, and families.
question: Has a major disaster affected you?

segments.say: The US now averages 20.4 billion-dollar disasters yearly, turning rare catastrophes into recurring bills.
The record year brought 28 disasters, more than triple the long-term average.
US billion-dollar disasters have cost 2.635 trillion dollars, spreading damage far beyond the communities directly hit.
